svg.aria-label: I'm a software engineer passionate about building real-world applications, intelligent systems, and scalable backend architectures. I enjoy working across the entire development lifecycle, from designing databases and building APIs to developing modern interfaces, integrating LLMs, and deploying production-ready applications. I am particularly interested in the intersection of Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, and Autonomous Agents.
